items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: My uncle was good friends with Shirley and Stan and you know Trudy Pitts, Jimmy McGriff, I followed every one of them.

ctx.x: Jimmy Smith. I followed all the organ players, every last one of them. Groove Holmes, Jimmy Smith, McDuff, Doctor Lonnie Smith, Shirley Scott. My uncle was good friends with Shirley and Stan and you know Trudy Pitts, Jimmy McGriff, I followed every one of them. You know I knew how they set up the organ, what kind of tunes they played using © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
the organ. You know some of them didn’t know what kind they was using themselves. But I followed all the organ players.
